name: SEED-Bench
description: SEED-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating generative comprehension capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). It contains 19,000 multiple choice questions spanning 12 evaluation dimensions covering both image and video modalities, enabling objective and efficient assessment without human or GPT intervention during evaluation.
reputation: A widely used early benchmark for multimodal LLM evaluation and a common reference in SEED series papers.
notes: Covers spatial and temporal understanding; includes automatic filtering and manual verification for question quality; leaderboard planned.
